review_evidence: REPL/JSON.lean defines CommandOptions, Command, File, ProofStep, Message, Sorry, Tactic, CommandResponse, and ProofStepResponse serialization-facing structures.
REPL/Lean/InfoTree.lean defines isSorryTactic/isSorryTerm, getUsedConstantsAsSet, findTacticNodes, sorries, tactics, goal-state formatting, and contextual MetaM runners.
REPL/Lean/Environment.lean, Replay.lean, ContextInfo.lean, Frontend.lean, and Snapshots.lean expose reusable environment/replay semantics; tests include actual declarations and theorems.
summary: Retain repl because it defines reusable Lean environment, info-tree, replay, serialization, and proof-state interfaces; its test sources also contain concrete theorem examples.
